# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 25 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 35 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_025_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 25

**1** Jesus said: "Love your brother as your own soul. Guard him like the apple of your eye."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Your brother" — the community member; not reduced to literal sibling
- "As your own soul" — the standard of love is one's deepest self, not merely one's body or wellbeing
- "Guard him" — the protective dimension of love; active, vigilant
- "Apple of your eye" — the Coptic idiom (eye of the eye = pupil); the most cherished and protected thing
- The saying is a compact community ethic: intense love + vigilant protection
